notes.title: 🎉 Steam Trading Cards Approved! Collect and Trade Now! 🎉
notes.content:

[/h3][p][b]What does this mean for you?[/b]
✔ [b]Collectible Cards[/b] – Earn them by playing or grab them on the Steam Market!
✔ [b]Stylish Badges[/b] – Level up and show them off!
✔ [b]Exclusive Backgrounds[/b] – Decorate your profile with atmospheric artwork.
✔ [b]Emoticons[/b] – Express yourself in chats with style![/p][p][/p][p]Collect full sets, trade with friends, and showcase your love for [i]Chronicles of Delight[/i] and [i]Whispers of Lust[/i]! 💖 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45613931/82161cba4cdc78b2917811332bb2f26865bf64c7.png"][/img][/p][p] [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3214690/Chronicles_of_Delights_Isekai_Adventure/"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3503570/Whispers_of_Lust/?curator_clanid=45077094"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: 🔥 Official Release: Whispers of Lust 🔥
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45613931/ef1e15a47d984a70b99606faa39fe48de80c8ff5.png[/img]
[h3]Dear players and fans of steamy adventures,[/h3]

We are proud to present the long-awaited [b]hentai visual novel [i]Whispers of Lust[/i][/b]—a tale where magic, intrigue, and burning desires intertwine!

[b]🔮 Step into the world of a mysterious academy[/b], where every student hides dark secrets, and lessons go far beyond ordinary sorcery…

[b]💋 Game Features:[/b]
✔ An immersive, choice-driven story.
✔ Unique heroines with "deep" backstories.
✔ Beautiful stylized artwork.
✔ Explicit animated 18+ scenes that bring your wildest fantasies to life.
✔ A dark, atmospheric soundtrack.

[b]🎁 As a special launch bonus, early players will receive an exclusive reward![/b]
